headline: ShelfMitra's Kolkata sales openings and StockSathi's ₹699 Pro with UPI Udhaar raise threat levels this week [ShelfMitra-2-3] [StockSathi-2-1]
tl_dr: ShelfMitra's reported ₹200 crore Series B and 15 new Kolkata sales openings signal an eastward push into our home market [ShelfMitra-2-2] [ShelfMitra-2-3] [ShelfMitra-2-4] [ShelfMitra-2-5].
StockSathi cut Pro from ₹999 to ₹699 (-30%) and bundled UPI Udhaar, store credit with automatic UPI reminders, launched 2026-10-13 [StockSathi-2-1] [StockSathi-2-2].
ShelfMitra added a bulk GST invoice export that downloads a month of invoices as one ZIP file [ShelfMitra-2-1].
BahiBook kept pricing unchanged (Solo ₹399, Plus ₹899), shipped only an A5 invoice print fix, and Pune hiring is unchanged [BahiBook-2-1] [BahiBook-2-2] [BahiBook-2-3].
StockSathi's app rating slipped from 4.4 to 4.3 across 18,469 reviews, with sync delays the top complaint [StockSathi-2-6].
since_last_week: Threat levels moved: ShelfMitra from low to high on new Kolkata hiring and funding [ShelfMitra-2-2] [ShelfMitra-2-3]; BahiBook from medium to low on unchanged pricing [BahiBook-2-1]; StockSathi stays high [StockSathi-2-1].
StockSathi's Pro plan fell from ₹999 to ₹699 with UPI Udhaar now included; the Pro cut was not in the week 1 brief [StockSathi-2-1] [StockSathi-2-2].
StockSathi's Basic (₹499) and Business (₹1,999) plans are unchanged [StockSathi-2-3] [StockSathi-2-4].
ShelfMitra's published prices are unchanged, and its Mumbai Backend Engineer and Product Designer roles remain listed [ShelfMitra-2-8] [ShelfMitra-2-6] [ShelfMitra-2-7].
StockSathi's careers page is unchanged (2 Android Engineer, 1 Customer Success, Bengaluru) [StockSathi-2-5]; BahiBook's Pune Customer Support opening is unchanged [BahiBook-2-3].

threats.rationale: Funding plus 15 new Kolkata sales openings point to a direct push into our home market, which raises ShelfMitra from low to high [ShelfMitra-2-2] [ShelfMitra-2-3] [ShelfMitra-2-4] [ShelfMitra-2-5]. The direct-push reading is an inference from hiring, not a confirmed launch.

The Pro cut to ₹699 with UPI Udhaar bundled is the sharpest price and feature move this week [StockSathi-2-1] [StockSathi-2-2]. Our Khata on UPI is not due until Q2 2027, so the feature gap stays open for now.
Pricing, Pune hiring, and the changelog are unchanged or minor, with nothing pointing to Kolkata [BahiBook-2-1] [BahiBook-2-2] [BahiBook-2-3].

recommendations.action: Decide the response to StockSathi's ₹699 Pro: lead with annual billing (2 months free) and feature value, and do not cut below the ₹649 floor without a board decision.
Assign named field reps to our top 200 Kolkata accounts within two weeks, per the defence rule for funded rivals hiring sales staff in Kolkata.
Confirm the Khata on UPI timing against StockSathi's UPI Udhaar and evaluate pulling the Q2 2027 release forward.

watchlist: Whether StockSathi's rating drop to 4.3 persists next week, with sync delays as the top complaint [StockSathi-2-6].
ShelfMitra's bulk GST export may partly overlap with our GST e-invoicing plans; the overlap is unconfirmed [ShelfMitra-2-1].
BahiBook's free one-hour GSTR-1 webinar for first-time filers, from a blog source with 0.6 credibility [BahiBook-2-4].
